test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The ratio of the ages of A and B, 8 years ago, was 5 ∶ 7. The ratio of their ages, 8 years from now, will be 9 ∶ 11. If the present age of C is 13 years less than that of B, and the present age of D is 8 years less than that of the age of A, then the sum of the present ages of C and D, in years, is :
solution:
Ratio of A and B, 8 years ago = 5 : 7

Ratio after 8 years from present = 9 : 11

Present age of C = Age of B - 13 years

Present age of D = Age of A - 8 years

Calculations:

Let the age of A and B eight years before be "5a" and "7a"

Age of A and B after 8 years from present = (5a + 16) and (7a + 16)

According to the question-

⇒ 5a+16over 7a+16 = 9over 11

Solving, we get-

⇒ 55a + 176 = 63a + 144 

⇒ 32 = 8a

⇒ a = 4

∴ Present age of A = (5a + 8) = (5 × 4 + 8) = 28 years

⇒ Present age of D = 28 - 8 = 20 years

∴ Present age of B = (7a + 8) = (7 × 4 + 8) = 36 years.

⇒ Present age of C = 36 - 13 = 23 years

∴ Sum of present age of C and D = 20 + 23 = 43 years

Hence, the sum of the present age of C and D is 43 years.
